availability_audit: Petalburg Gym is challenged in C27; cap 42 until Norman's badge at the end of the Gym. No Surf. Every member is in work/reference-pools/pool-42.json with gate <= 42 and a source map walked by C26. Lucarionite stone-window 14 and Lucario base-window 14, both long cleared; Mega Ring from Steven in C13. Route 118 and New Mauville sources excluded. No legendary or mythical; Kartana is an Ultra Beast, permitted above the cap-24 window, native to Petalburg Woods from C05.
plan: Berke's crack list is explicit: replace the weather and the room loses Blizzard accuracy, Cetitan's Speed and the Ice Defense boost in one move, and Fighting, Steel and Fire all cut through. This party brings all four. Torkoal is here purely as the weather test - Drought on entry should overwrite Snow Warning - and it is the one slot I am spending on an experiment rather than on damage. Mega Lucario is the Mega: Adaptability makes Close Combat and Meteor Mash 2x-STAB, Fighting is 2x into all six members, and Steel is 4x into Aurorus's Rock/Ice. Kartana's Smart Strike and Aegislash's Flash Cannon are the other two Steel routes into Aurorus. Incineroar and Chandelure are the Fire half, 2x into the three Ice bodies. Declared in advance and important: Scrappy on Exploud and Kangaskhan means my Ghost typing does NOT blank their Normal and Fighting moves, so Chandelure and Aegislash are not safe switch-ins against those two specifically.
